name: Leovee full-stack
install:
set -euo pipefail
cd backend && pip install -e ".[dev]"
cd ../frontend && npm ci
start:
if command -v dockerd >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dockerd --storage-driver=vfs >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; fi
if [ -f docker-compose.agent.yml ]; then export LEOVEE_COMPOSE_EXTRA="-f docker-compose.agent.yml"; fi
true

terminals.name: api-dev
terminals.description: FastAPI dev server (requires DATABASE_URL / Redis for full readiness)
